title: Blog | Push Provisioning for Digital Wallets
summary: Provision cards to a mobile wallet with CPI’s integrated SaaS-based service that utilizes APIs with in app-provisioning technology
body_markdown:
Provision cards to a mobile wallet, adding contactless convenience to your digital strategy


## Meet consumer demand while delivering real-time experiences with Web or In-App


Push Provisioning is CPI’s integrated SaaS-based service that facilitates the provisioning of debit or credit card payment credentials to a cardholder’s digital wallet. Extend your central and instant issuance strategy with a digital payment solution and give cardholders the options they want.


[Get Started with CPI](https://cpicardgroup.com/contact-us/)


## How it Works


### Web


Web Push Provisioning (WPP) performs the same provisioning process as In-App, but through a web browser which removes the requirement to have a mobile app.


A button is added to the issuer’s website to initiate provisioning directly with the wallet provider.


Promote this seamless experience to your cardholders to unlock new engagement opportunities.


### In-App


Push Provisioning utilizes APIs with In-App provisioning technology to facilitate the provisioning of debit or credit card payment credentials to a cardholder’s digital wallet.


When a card request is processed, the financial institution sends an API request to CPI to provision the card. CPI calls the association’s secure vault to generate a token, then tokenizes the card and adds it to the cardholder’s digital wallet for immediate use.

## Flexible Options. Convenient Solutions.


Now, financial institutions can facilitate the provisioning of debit or credit card payment credentials to a digital wallet and accommodate an ever-growing contactless world with physical card and digital solutions.
